extracted.intended_audience: State Department and USAID press officers, embassy public affairs officers, agency communicators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for drafting and clearing U.S. State Department and USAID international press releases, including coordination, content components, multilingual and diplomatic considerations, and agency‑specific data requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond to press
rubrics_metrics.description: The press office must be prepared to respond to media inquiries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain responsiveness as a core press office responsibility; coordinate responses with relevant program and policy offices when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Present agency mission and message
rubrics_metrics.description: Press outputs should present and advance the agency's mission and messaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure releases align with agency priorities and approved messaging; avoid ad hoc statements that conflict with strategic communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate press goals and messages
rubrics_metrics.description: Press activities must be coordinated to unify goals and messages across the agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use internal coordination processes and messaging templates to maintain consistency; engage relevant stakeholders early.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor agency-related media
rubrics_metrics.description: The press office should monitor media coverage related to the agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track coverage to inform proactive outreach and corrections; disseminate findings to staff as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disseminate media coverage to staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure relevant media coverage is shared internally with agency staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use internal distribution lists and summaries to keep stakeholders informed of media narratives and issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generate proactive agency press activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Create proactive press activities (releases, briefings, outreach) rather than only reactive responses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan proactive campaigns tied to milestones, programming, or diplomatic events to shape public understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select appropriate release type
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the proper product type (statement, media note, notice to the press, fact sheet) as issued by the Office of the Spokesperson.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the format that best fits content and timing; consult Spokesperson Office templates and conventions for each type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use press material templates for headquarters releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Headquarters-originated releases must follow approved press material templates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Templates ensure formatting, required fields, and clearance expectations are met; deviation requires justification and additional coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission consultation with State Department Public Affairs
rubrics_metrics.description: Overseas missions should consult with State Department Public Affairs when preparing releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Early coordination prevents inconsistencies and diplomatic missteps; consult country desks and Public Affairs for messaging guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow embassy guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: When applicable, releases must follow the host embassy's guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Embassy guidance may reflect local sensitivities, legal considerations, and operational constraints—adhere to it for local matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate across time zones
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan timing and coordination of releases with attention to different time zones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedule distribution and clearances accounting for local and headquarters working hours to ensure synchronized messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translate for affected populations
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide translations for populations affected by the content of the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure translations reach intended audiences and are linguistically and culturally appropriate; indicate translation availability in the release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain original English version
rubrics_metrics.description: Retain the original English text even when translations are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: English version serves as authoritative text for archival, legal, and policy review; translations should be clearly labeled as such.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culturally appropriate adaptation
rubrics_metrics.description: Adapt translations and messaging to local cultural norms and sensitivities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond literal translation, adjust phrasing and examples to avoid misinterpretation; consult local staff and cultural experts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider local context
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporate local political, social, and media context into messaging decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how content may be received locally and tailor emphasis or disclaimers accordingly; coordinate with country teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid characterizations of foreign governments
rubrics_metrics.description: Refrain from making character judgments or adversarial characterizations about foreign governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use factual, neutral descriptions; coordinate with country desks to ensure language is diplomatically appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use neutral language
rubrics_metrics.description: Employ neutral, non-inflammatory wording in international releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Neutral language reduces risk of escalation or misinterpretation; prioritize tone that supports diplomatic engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate with country desks
rubrics_metrics.description: All messaging with country implications should be coordinated with the appropriate country desk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Country desks provide policy context, clearance pathways, and diplomatic risk assessment—engage them early in drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid creating diplomatic incidents
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft and clear releases to minimize the risk of unintended diplomatic incidents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag sensitive topics for senior review; use vetted language and clearance chains when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide date with time zone
rubrics_metrics.description: Every international release must include the date and the applicable time zone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time-zone disclosure ensures clarity about timing for international audiences and for recordkeeping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include distribution list (US + international)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify distribution targets, including U.S. and international media and stakeholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document who was notified and through what channels; tailor distribution lists to the release’s relevance across regions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embassy/mission attribution when applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute the release to the relevant embassy or mission when appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clear attribution signals source and responsibility; include mission contact information as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Note translation availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate within the release whether translations are available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide links or instructions for obtaining translations; state which languages are available if relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include cultural advisory when applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach cultural advisories when content may require special handling or explanation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advisories can warn audiences or staff about sensitive references or local implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose appropriate topics (common topics guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Typical international press release topics include diplomatic statements, treaty announcements, aid commitments, travel/visa advisories, sanctions, recognitions, human rights statements, disaster response, and election-related statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this list to identify suitable release subjects; topics may trigger different clearance paths and sensitivity reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify funding amount for aid announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: Aid-related releases must state the specific funding amount being committed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify funds clearly (currency, total amount) and avoid vague phrasing; clarify whether amounts are estimates or final.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify source of funds (agency/program)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the agency or program providing the funds for aid announcements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify budget lines or program names to ensure transparency and proper attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name recipient organization or country
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the recipient organization and/or country for aid commitments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide correct legal or organizational names and, where relevant, location details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe purpose/use of funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain the intended purpose or use of the funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be specific about activities or objectives funded to set expectations for impact and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: List implementation partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose implementing partners working to execute the funded activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include governmental, NGO, or contractor partners; clarify roles and responsibilities where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: State performance period
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the timeframe or performance period for funded activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify start/end dates or duration and any relevant milestones or reporting periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide expected impact metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe anticipated metrics or indicators of impact for aid-funded programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include measurable targets or evaluation criteria if available to support accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate with country teams for aid announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: Engage country teams in planning and messaging of aid-related releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Country teams advise on local implementation realities and political sensitivities; coordination improves accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge incidents in crisis response messaging
rubrics_metrics.description: Crisis response releases should acknowledge the event or issue being addressed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledge with appropriate tone and factual detail; avoid speculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: State aid commitment in crisis response
rubrics_metrics.description: Publicly specify the agency's aid commitment when responding to crises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include amounts, types of assistance, and delivery mode where available; be clear about timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate with other agencies for crisis response
rubrics_metrics.description: Crisis messaging must be coordinated with other U.S. agencies and partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Joint communication avoids mixed messages and clarifies roles in response operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include guidance on how to help when appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: If suitable, crisis releases should inform the public how they can assist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide vetted channels for donations or volunteering and warn against unofficial solicitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide information sources (where to get info)
rubrics_metrics.description: State where audiences can get more information (contacts, websites, hotlines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include authoritative links and embassy or mission contact details to direct inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow approved clearance chain
rubrics_metrics.description: Releases must be approved through the proper institutional clearance processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track approvals, involve legal and policy review when required, and document the clearance trail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cite specific facts, avoid generalizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Use verifiable, specific facts in releases rather than vague general statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support claims with data, dates, and sources; avoid unsourced assertions that could be challenged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure Section 508 compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure releases and associated materials meet Section 508 accessibility requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accessible formats (alt text, readable PDFs, captioned video) so content is usable by people with disabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proper spokesperson attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute statements correctly to the designated spokesperson or office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include name and title when appropriate; ensure the attributed person has cleared the messaging and has authority.
